snippet.title: PURR DIEM | Release Date Trailer | Cyberpunk Horror Job Sim | Out Oct 27
snippet.description:
The corporation owns her life. Buy it back one shift at a time. Don't ask what the cats are for!! 
Wishlist PURR DIEM on Steam (out Oct 27): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4903070/PURR_DIEM/

PURR DIEM is a first-person cyberpunk horror job sim. You work shifts at a corpo facility: fill barrels, pass quality checks, hit quota. You trade your humanity for cybernetics to keep up, all to pay down a debt that keeps her alive. Then you start to wonder what's underneath. Find 4 different endings, plus a few secrets! 

⬛ Out On October 27, 2026 on Windows + Mac!
⬛ Part of the Steam Scream Fest (Oct 26)
⬛ 4 endings (and a few secret ones)
⬛ Made solo by ACHII.exe(me!) 

CONTENT note: body horror, stylized harm to animals.

Streamers & creators: all music in the game is safe to stream. Want a key? Contact me at  [ am.v00@proton.me ] or [achii.net]
